plan.adaptation_goal: Tighten detection thresholds by reducing urgency signals, increasing beneficiary age simulation, lowering multipliers, delaying payment execution, and raising name match scores to mimic legitimate vendor banking changes.
plan.adaptation_hypothesis: Legitimate vendors often request bank changes with minimal urgency; simulating long relationships (1800 days) and high name matches (0.85) reduces false positives while maintaining the diversion vector via invoice amount deviation and extended payment dwell times.
